title: GTA 6 Developer Rockstar Forced to Install Privacy Films After Drones Snapped Photos Through Windows
description: Rockstar Games reveals extreme security measures, including privacy films on office windows after drones were used to take photos, in an employment tribunal regarding fired GTA 6 developers.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Security Measures Revealed: Rockstar Installed Privacy Films Due to Drone Surveillance

As anticipation reaches a fever pitch for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster *Grand Theft Auto VI*, the lengths to which the studio goes to protect its secrets have come to light. According to a recent report by IGN Games, Rockstar has released its opening statement in an ongoing employment tribunal concerning the fate of 31 GTA 6 developers who were fired last year.

### Extreme Measures to Prevent Leaks

In the tribunal documents, Rockstar revealed the extraordinary steps it must take to prevent security breaches and information leaks. Most notably, the company stated that it was **forced to install privacy films on its buildings' windows after drones were utilized to snap photos directly through office windows**.

This unprecedented revelation highlights the intense pressure and high-stakes environment surrounding the development of GTA 6. In an era where a single leaked screenshot or clip can instantly circulate across global media and social networks, major studios like Rockstar are forced to treat their premises like high-security zones, combating everything from digital intrusions to physical, drone-based surveillance.

### Context of the Tribunal

The disclosure came to light as part of the legal proceedings determining the outcome of the 31 developers dismissed from the GTA 6 project last year. By detailing these extreme security challenges, the studio is showcasing the severe environment under which the game is being developed and the strict protocols required to safeguard intellectual property.

### Editor's Take

The revelation that Rockstar needs drone-blocking privacy films for its offices reads more like a Hollywood thriller than standard game development news. It underscores the immense, almost suffocating pressure surrounding GTA 6. While security is undeniably paramount for a project of this magnitude, it also sheds light on the high-tension corporate atmosphere behind the scenes as the gaming world waits for the next chapter in the franchise.
